tour.name: Cape Sounion Private Sunset Tour: The Temple of Poseidon & the Athens Riviera
tour.subtitle: A private half day along the coast south of Athens with your own driver and a licensed guide: the beaches and coves of the Athens Riviera, a swim at Lake Vouliagmeni, and sunset at the Temple of Poseidon on its cliff above the Aegean, followed by a seafood dinner by the sea.

tour.overview:
At the southern tip of Attica, where the land ends in a cliff above the Aegean, the ancient Athenians built a temple to Poseidon, god of the sea, around 440 BC. Sailors returning home saw its white columns long before they saw the city, and according to legend King Aegeus threw himself from this cliff when he saw the black sails of his son Theseus's ship. Sixteen of the original Doric columns still stand, and at sunset they glow gold against the sea.

This private half day follows the coast road south from Athens, past the beaches and marinas of the Athens Riviera, with a stop to swim in Lake Vouliagmeni, a brackish lake fed by warm springs. You reach Cape Sounion in time to visit the temple with your guide before sunset, watch the sun go down over the islands, and end with a seafood dinner in a taverna by the water.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: about 6 hours (afternoon and evening)
• Start and end: your hotel in Athens
• Type: private tour with car, driver and licensed guide
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy; a short uphill walk to the temple

WHAT YOU SEE
• The coast road of the Athens Riviera: Glyfada, Vouliagmeni and Varkiza.
• Lake Vouliagmeni.
• The Temple of Poseidon at Cape Sounion.
• The sunset over the Saronic Gulf.

WHY THIS WORKS
We time the visit to the sunset of your date, arrive before the coaches and leave after them, and finish with dinner instead of the rush back to the city.

WHO IT SUITS
Couples, families and anyone with a free afternoon in Athens, especially after a morning at the Acropolis.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
If you want a full day of ancient sites, choose our Delphi or Mycenae and Epidaurus tours.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
The temple is open until sunset; times change through the year and we adapt the departure. It can be windy on the cape, even in summer. Bring a swimsuit and towel for the lake.

days.name: The Athens Riviera, Lake Vouliagmeni, the Temple of Poseidon at sunset and a seafood dinner
days.description:
What to expect: the coast south of Athens and the most beautiful sunset in Attica, with a private car, a licensed guide, tickets and dinner.

Your driver collects you at your hotel in the afternoon – about 15:00 in summer, earlier in winter, depending on the time of sunset. You drive down to the sea at Faliro and follow the coast road south through Glyfada, with its marinas and cafés, to Vouliagmeni. Here you stop at Lake Vouliagmeni, a lake of brackish water under a limestone cliff, fed by underground springs that keep it between 22 and 29 °C all year. You can swim, float among the tiny fish that nibble at your feet, or relax on a sunbed.

The road continues along a coast of coves and pine trees, with views to the islands of Aegina and Poros, to Cape Sounion. Your guide meets you at the site and leads you up to the Temple of Poseidon, built around 440 BC in white marble from nearby Agrileza, on the site of an older temple destroyed by the Persians. You see the sixteen surviving columns, the remains of the fortress that protected the shipping lanes to the silver mines of Lavrion, and, on a column at the entrance, the name of Lord Byron, who carved it during his visit in 1810 and wrote of 'Sunium's marbled steep'. As the sun sets over the Saronic Gulf, the columns turn gold and pink.

After sunset you walk down to a taverna by the sea for dinner: grilled fish of the day, calamari, Greek salad and a glass of white wine from Attica. Your driver then takes you back to your hotel in Athens, about an hour away, arriving at about 21:30 in summer.

SCHEDULE (approximate times, summer)
15:00 – Pick-up at your hotel in Athens.
15:45 – Lake Vouliagmeni (about 1 hour 15 minutes).
17:30 – Coast road to Cape Sounion.
18:15 – Temple of Poseidon with your guide.
20:00 – Sunset.
20:15 – Dinner at a seaside taverna.
21:45 – Back at your hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• In winter the tour starts around 13:00 and ends around 19:30.
• Lake Vouliagmeni can be replaced by a swim at a beach on the way.
• The tour can be combined with the Acropolis in the morning for a full day.

INCLUDED: private car and driver, licensed guide at Sounion, Temple of Poseidon ticket, Lake Vouliagmeni entrance, dinner, bottled water, hotel pick-up and drop-off.
NOT INCLUDED: sunbeds, extra drinks, tips.

Overnight: none.
Meals: dinner.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: What time does the tour start?
faq.answer: It depends on the time of sunset on your date: around 15:00 in summer and 13:00 in winter. We confirm the exact time with you.

faq.question: Are the entrance tickets included?
faq.answer: Yes: the Temple of Poseidon and Lake Vouliagmeni.

faq.question: Is dinner included?
faq.answer: Yes, a seafood dinner at a seaside taverna with a drink. Vegetarian and other diets can be arranged.

faq.question: Can we swim?
faq.answer: Yes, at Lake Vouliagmeni or at a beach on the coast road. Bring a swimsuit and towel; changing rooms are available at the lake.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. Children love the warm lake and the story of King Aegeus. Child seats are provided free of charge on request.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Partly. The path to the temple is short but uphill on rough ground. The lake has paved areas. Tell us your needs.

faq.question: Is it crowded at sunset?
faq.answer: Sunset is the most popular time. We arrive early to enjoy the temple before the crowds and find a good place for the sunset.

faq.question: Can we combine it with the Acropolis?
faq.answer: Yes. Many travellers do the Acropolis in the morning and Sounion in the afternoon; ask us for the combined day.

faq.question: Can you pick us up from the cruise ship?
faq.answer: Only if your ship stays in Piraeus into the evening; we plan the return before all-aboard time.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Comfortable shoes, a swimsuit, and a light jacket: the cape is often windy after sunset.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: All year. May to October for swimming; winter sunsets are early but often spectacularly clear.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the tour. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
